description: Spell sounds for an RPG -- a charge that gathers, the cast that releases it, fire, lightning and ice, a heal, and the fizzle when it fails. Written per machine against that synth's own architecture and measured at one key. Grouped by spell, so stepping down the list plays the same one on each machine in turn.

patches.name: charge  [Bucket ONE]
patches.description: the gather -- everything stacked at 16' and 8', vibrato fading in late over a slow filter

patches.name: charge  [FB-7999]
patches.description: the gather -- Auto Bend running the whole way up, swelling in behind it

patches.name: charge  [Fury68]
patches.description: the gather -- PWM widening under a filter sweep, vibrato arriving late

patches.name: charge  [Fury800]
patches.description: the gather -- the whole 8'+4'+2' stack on both oscillators, filter climbing under it

patches.name: charge  [Kern]
patches.description: the gather -- FM depth climbing off the envelope, filter opening with it

patches.name: charge  [MonoFury]
patches.description: the gather -- all four oscillators, one per footing, filter climbing under them

patches.name: charge  [MPS]
patches.description: the gather -- morphing from the dark corner to the bright one, slowly, the whole way

patches.name: charge  [Nabla]
patches.description: the gather -- the String section swelling under a filter sweep, phased

patches.name: charge  [NY]
patches.description: the gather -- both string ranks swelling in with the chorus, vibrato under them

patches.name: charge  [Oxid]

patches.name: charge  [Paralogy]

patches.name: charge  [PECS]

patches.name: charge  [Ragnarok2]
patches.description: the gather -- FM depth climbing off the envelope, saw ranks opening behind it

patches.name: charge  [Sequencair]
patches.description: the gather -- sixteen steps climbing from the key you played, which is a rise you can count

patches.name: charge  [TAL-U-No-62]
patches.description: the gather -- filter climbing from shut, the LFO delayed so the shimmer arrives late

patches.name: charge  [Tricent]
patches.description: the gather -- Strings swelling under a Synthe filter sweep, vibrato arriving late, flanged

patches.name: cast  [Nabla]

patches.name: cast  [Oxid]
